note: #2767 item 12 (only the first "## Acceptance Criteria" heading is ever evaluated): the primary section-scoped ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_PATTERN match in checkVerifiability has no global flag, so only the first heading is ever located -- confirmed: a placeholder-only first section followed by a later, substantive second section fails Check 7 (verifiability) when the second section's real bullet is a bare (non-checkbox) list item, as authored here. The primary-scan gap is present today (MATCH); a research variant using this repo's own checkbox+outcome-word convention on the second section's bullet was sometimes rescued by a separate whole-body fallback further down the same function, so whether the final verdict flips depends on downstream bullet formatting -- this entry's own bare-bullet body reliably exercises the failing case. Unrelated to item 12's own claim: checkAutonomy (Check 6) also fails on this body, because its own literal "- TBD" placeholder bullet independently matches the UNRESOLVED_CHOICE_SOURCE pattern -- an artifact of the placeholder text choice, not a #2767 gap.
